proofBoundary.fixtureLevel: Actual handler code with synthetic dependencies. Root auth-provider and leaf injected auth failures are distinct, not live expiry/revocation evidence.
proofBoundary.rewardReplay: Invocation counts and synthetic receipts do not prove SQL locking, conservation, race safety or replay. Preserve the existing RPC; never substitute older Staff reward-then-mark behavior.
proofBoundary.credentialReplay: Request-id and idempotency-key are not credential RPC parameters. Repeated or changed payload behavior is characterized, not labeled idempotent.
proofBoundary.noNormalization: No identity/error/order/money/currency/effect field is scrubbed. Contract clock and credential material are injected; identifier-only updated_at is checked against its execution interval.
proofBoundary.downstreamUse: Later refactors preserve these observations or separately authorize corrections. No deletion, external-consumer clearance, runtime certification or later REF implementation is granted.
